name: Smucker's Spreads/Toppings - Orrville OH
type: Manufacturing - Fruit spreads, syrups, ice cream toppings

fieldNotes.truckGate: South truck driveway opens directly onto the public road with no barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point (Street View Apr-2023, Jan-2025). Open uncontrolled entrance into the drop yard / dock area.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at the south entrance; only a small free-standing yard sign. No booth structure visible at any campus truck access.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: False because there is no controlled truck gate at all.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Large internal yard between the open entrance and the dock bank can hold a deep queue of 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide unmarked paved entrance apron and ample yard width — physical room to add an express lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Main dock bank on the east face shows ~14 trailers backed in; additional dock faces on other building sides bring the site total into the 25-50 band. Count is an overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Multiple dedicated trailer-storage rows south and southeast of the dock bank, 70+ trailers visible, capacity well above 50.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus of 8+ large buildings: corporate HQ, the main manufacturing/distribution complex, original Orrville plant buildings to the north, and SE warehouse/storage structures.
fieldNotes.railServed: An active rail line runs north-south through the campus with at least one spur toward the buildings.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale clearly visible in overhead imagery; flagged as uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Orrville is a small Ohio town (~8,300 pop); the campus sits at the edge of town with farmland directly east and south.
